Intermediate.learningGoal: Build and transform cold Flows with map, filter, take and terminal operators.
gotchas: Cold flows rerun for each collector
take cancels the upstream after N items
flow builder code runs in the collector's context; use flowOn to change it
goodSolutionShows: Operators composed on Flow rather than collecting into lists early
toList or first as terminal operators in tests
shapeHints: a Flow of readings filtered and averaged in windows
paging through a source producing a Flow
emitting ticks driven by an injected delay in virtual time

Advanced.learningGoal: Handle errors, retry, combine and buffer flows.
gotchas: combine emits when any source emits after all have emitted once, zip pairs one-to-one
buffer and conflate change which values are seen
goodSolutionShows: catch and retry placement relative to operators
Deterministic tests via runTest and virtual time
shapeHints: a retrying Flow with a deterministic failure sequence
combining a price Flow and a currency Flow
a debounce implementation tested with virtual time

Expert.learningGoal: Work with hot flows: StateFlow, SharedFlow and custom operators.
gotchas: SharedFlow replay and buffer overflow settings decide lost events
A collector that is slow can suspend emitters
goodSolutionShows: StateFlow for state and SharedFlow for events
Custom operator via flow { collect { } } or transform
Tests collecting into a list inside backgroundScope with runTest
shapeHints: an event bus with replay semantics
a derived StateFlow computed from two sources
a custom chunked-by-time operator with an injected clock
